name: RWTH Aachen University
summary: Technical university in Aachen, on the Dutch and Belgian border; its bachelor's all require German, even those partly taught in English.

ib.text: Every bachelor's needs German at DSH-2, TestDaF 4 in all four parts, or Goethe C1, and your IB subjects must meet the KMK rule. You apply direct in RWTHonline, free of charge.

notes: RWTH has not published its 2027 window; for winter 2026/27 applications ran from 4 May to 15 July 2026.
Some bachelor's, such as Computer Science and Business Administration, ask for English as well as German, because parts are taught in English.
The 2.5 minimum grade (about 33 IB points) applies to non-EU applicants; EU and EEA citizens are treated like German applicants.
